title: Not All Agents Are Equal: Code Quality and Post-Merge Maintenance Across Five Autonomous Coding Agents in the Wild
abstract: arXiv:2609.17598v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous coding agents now open pull requests in public repositories at a scale that was out of reach two years ago, yet little is known about what happens to that code after it lands. This paper studies 37,623 provenance-labeled pull requests (PRs) from five commercial agents (OpenAI Codex, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and Claude Code) and a matched human baseline, drawn from 2,807 GitHub repositories between December 2024 and July 2025. We combine the AIDev dataset with 58,792 cached GitHub API responses to measure security smells in added code, structural maintainability, post-merge churn, revert rates, and human review behavior. Three results stand out. translated_title: 并非所有智能体都生而平等：五种自主编码智能体在真实环境中的代码质量与合并后维护研究
translated_abstract: 自主编码智能体如今在公共仓库中发起拉取请求的规模在两年前是难以企及的，然而这些代码被合入之后的境况却鲜为人知。本文研究了37,623个带有来源标签的拉取请求（PR），这些请求来自五个商业智能体（OpenAI Codex、Devin、GitHub Copilot、Cursor和Claude Code）以及匹配的人类基线，样本取自2024年12月至2025年7月间的2,807个GitHub仓库。我们将AIDev数据集与58,792条缓存的GitHub API响应相结合，用于衡量新增代码中的安全缺陷、结构可维护性、合并后的代码变更量、回退率以及人类审查行为。有三个结果尤为突出。第一，质量差异因厂商而异，并非整齐划一：Codex生成的PR被回退的频率约为人类PR的一半（6.1%对11.5%，比值比0.50），而Devin生成的PR被回退的频率则更高（14.5%，比值比1.31）。第二，跨厂商汇总的智能体代码……
tldr: 该研究基于对37,623个拉取请求的大规模实证分析，首次揭示了不同商业自主编码智能体生成的代码在合并后维护质量上存在显著的厂商特异性差异——Codex代码的回退率仅为人类代码的一半，而Devin代码的回退率反而高于人类，表明“智能体代码质量”并非铁板一块。
en_tdlr: A large-scale empirical study of 37,623 pull requests reveals that code quality and post-merge maintenance of autonomous coding agents are vendor-specific rather than uniform, with Codex-authored PRs reverted at half the rate of human PRs while Devin PRs are reverted more often.
